02 — How it works

From your list to your gate in four steps.

No account, no minimum, no walking between suppliers. Every stage ends with something in writing.

01

Send your list

Type items into the quote form, paste an existing list, upload an LPO or BQ, or send a photo of a handwritten note on WhatsApp.

2 minutes

02

We source and price it

We check availability with our suppliers, confirm specifications with you where needed, and return one itemised quotation.

Within 24 hours

03

You approve

Approve by email, WhatsApp or LPO. Payment terms are agreed in writing before we dispatch — no surprises on delivery day.

Written terms

04

We deliver, complete

Goods arrive on the agreed date with a delivery note and invoice. Short-supplied items are flagged before dispatch, not after.

Agreed date

03 — Why buyers use us

Procurement without the phone calls.

One list, one invoice

Fertiliser, timber, sprayers and gumboots normally mean four suppliers and four invoices. We consolidate the whole order into one quotation, one delivery and one paper trail.

Sourcing is our job, not yours

You don’t need to know which distributor holds stock this week. Tell us the item and the quantity; finding it is what we do.

Priced to be compared

Quotations show unit price, pack size, quantity and delivery separately, so procurement can compare us line by line against any other supplier.

Order sizes that suit you

No minimum order. A single knapsack sprayer for a smallholder gets the same quotation format as a 300-bag fertiliser order for an estate.

Delivery dates we hold to

We commit to a date only after confirming stock. If part of an order will be late, you hear it before dispatch — while you can still decide.

Documentation institutions need

Quotations, delivery notes, invoices and registration details in the format schools, NGOs and county buyers require for their files.

05 — About Sisili

A supply company built around the buyer’s list.

Sisili General Supplies is a Nairobi-based supply and procurement company serving farms, agri-businesses, co-operatives, institutions and projects across Kenya. We buy from established distributors and manufacturers, consolidate the order, and deliver it complete.

We exist because sourcing is where time and money leak: a farm manager needing fertiliser, timber, sprayers and gumboots normally deals with four suppliers, four invoices and four delivery dates. We take the whole list.

Common questions

Do you deliver outside Nairobi?
Yes — upcountry delivery is quoted per location and load, shown as a separate line on your quotation.
Is there a minimum order?
No. Small orders and single items are quoted the same way as bulk orders.
Can you work with an LPO?
Yes. Send the LPO with your request and we’ll respond with matching documentation.
What if an item isn’t on your list?
Send it anyway. Special orders are routine — we source against your specification.
